title: MaskedMimic: Unify Control Inputs as Physics-Based Motion Inpainting
content_lines: Source: [arXiv:2409.14393v1](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.14393v1). Code mapping refers to the pinned official ProtoMotions revision linked by the Chinese page.

> **Bottom line:** MaskedMimic first trains an RL tracker with full future motion, then uses DAgger to distill it into a conditional-VAE student that sees randomly masked goals. One student accepts full motion, VR head/hands, arbitrary joint keyframes, text, and objects; it unifies the interface, not long-horizon planning or robot deployment.
## Engineering problem

Full-body tracking, sparse VR, keyframes, text, and scene interaction are usually separate controllers. Each sensor subset multiplies policies and switching logic. The common problem is completing a dynamically executable body motion from partial constraints.
## Method

The fully constrained teacher maps complete future poses and scene observations to PD targets. The student learns on its own visited states through DAgger. An encoder sees full targets during training, while a learned prior sees only partial goals; inference discards the encoder and samples the prior. Structured temporal/body masks cover real command patterns.

The two stages separate learning physical tracking from learning incomplete-condition completion.
![Tables 1-2: full-body and VR tracking](../assets/maskedmimic-2409.14393/table-1-2-tracking.jpg)
The same weights handle dense and sparse conditions in simulation; this is not real-sensor or robot evidence.
![Tables 3-5: sparsity, terrain, and tasks](../assets/maskedmimic-2409.14393/table-3-5-sparsity-tasks.jpg)
The tables test interface breadth, while goal-engineering tasks still use explicit FSM logic.
## Decisive evidence

The sitting ablation drops from 96.9% to 21.1% without the residual prior and to 0% without structured masking. The paper also reports jitter, difficult flips/breakdance, weak long-horizon text, and terrain-planning limits.
## Paper-to-implementation mapping

The pinned code exposes mask shifting/sampling in `MaskedMimicControl`, the VAE student in `MaskedMimicModel`, sparse observation construction, and tests for model/loss/masks. Effective mask frequencies and condition contradictions still need explicit logging.
## Limits and evidence boundary

Masks model missing targets, not necessarily biased, delayed, or misidentified sensors. Contradictory multimodal constraints have no formal infeasibility certificate. Training is extremely large-scale and all evidence concerns simulated characters rather than real humanoids.
## Bounded engineering takeaway

Version the full-goal teacher and the exact mask distribution as separate artifacts. Evaluate modality × sparsity × delay × terrain, preserve sampled latent and mask bitmap for failures, and reject inconsistent conditions above the model.
## Reproduction checklist

Lock data splits, scene/retargeting, teacher, prioritized sampling, DAgger, masks, history/keyframes, VAE/KL schedule, PD, and seeds. Run no-structured-mask, no-residual-prior, no-history, and no-VAE ablations; report constraint error, diversity, contacts, failures, and compute.
